protocol.threshold_selected_on: development positives and development negatives only
protocol.threshold_tie_break: balanced accuracy, then positive accept rate, then lower threshold

topical_grade_provenance.method: two independent Claude gradings, then hand adjudication of every disagreement
topical_grade_provenance.caveat: Claude-vs-Claude second opinion, not human inter-annotator agreement.

protocol.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

claim_boundary: Graded relevance over paraphrase, lexical, and pooled-topical queries plus out-of-domain and near-miss negatives. Queries were LLM-authored (Claude); topical relevance grades were LLM-drafted and re-graded blind by a human before freeze (see topical_grade_disagreement in protocol). Held-out questions were authored from a fresh sample disjoint from the development sample and were not dry-run before freeze. Paraphrase queries are relatively long, abstract-style rewrites and are therefore easier for dense retrieval than terse user queries. This is not user-traffic relevance.
abstention_note: not measured: the abstention gate needs both splits and this run evaluated only ['heldout']
